caption: John James Audubon, American Beaver, plate 46 from The Viviparous Quadrupeds of North America (1845–1848), hand-coloured lithograph
alt: A hand-coloured print of two beavers on a mossy bank by still water: one, upright against a leaning trunk, gnaws a deep notch into it, wood chips piled at its feet and its broad scaly tail trailing down; the other crouches at the water's edge with orange teeth bared, and a lodge shows in the pond behind.
bibliography: Audubon, John James. Castor Fiber Americanus, Linn. American Beaver, plate 46 from The Viviparous Quadrupeds of North America. 1845–1848, hand-coloured lithograph, William L. Clements Library, University of Michigan.
title: American Beaver
